description: Works to site after vehicle impact including insulation and preservation treatments, rebuild and render of West side brick wall, timber frame repair and treatment at front North and East elevation, with internal works repairs, insulation and preservation to damaged walls, ceiling and floor including timbers of ground floor, repairs to first floor bathroom as required.
decision_conditions: The works approved by this Listed Building Consent must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this decision notice. Reason: To comply with S.51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Existing Elevations Proposed Elevations Existing First FloorExisting Ground Floor Existing Section Proposed First Floor Proposed Ground Floor Proposed Section Location Plan Heritage statement Site Photos Timber Report Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The removal of external render and internal wall finishes shall be carried out solely by hand or by non-mechanical tools held in the hand, without the use of power-driven tools, to safeguard the underlying historic fabric.Reason: To safeguard the character and appearance of the Grade II listed building

Notwithstanding the approved drawings and reports, prior to the commencement of development, a detailed schedule of works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, including supporting drawings and a condition report specifying the location, methodology and materials for all proposed repairs. Unless otherwise agreed, the repair works shall match existing historic materials in composition, colour, texture and finish. All repair works shall be carried out in full accordance with the details as set out in the schedule and drawings. The repair works shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved details.Reason: To safeguard the character and appearance of the Grade II listed building

Any elements that are required to be temporarily removed as part of the works, including but not limited to windows and rainwater goods, shall be carefully removed, securely stored, and reinstated in their original positions upon completion of the relevant phase of works. The local planning authority shall be notified in writing within one working day of any loss or damage to these items. The development shall not be occupied until remedial works have been agreed in writing by the local planning authority and implemented in full.Reason: To safeguard the character and appearance of the Grade II listed building
